messages.text: can we grab 20 min tomorrow? the promo code field on staging eats the first character every time you type into it and I'd rather show you than try to describe it

morning! four people on my team ran the checkout on staging yesterday, mostly clean, but two got stuck at the shipping step and couldn't get past it. are you free weds afternoon

canceling weds, sorry. my boss asked to pause everything non-critical until we get through the board update on the 19th. I know that's frustrating, it's frustrating here too. nothing to do with your team.
you free for a quick call. the staging site was down for like 40 min this morning and I had two people ask me about it

grab time monday? want to go through the bug list together instead of the two of us pinging in here all day

still ok for friday? also did anyone look at the mobile nav thing I posted tuesday, it kind of went quiet

so the 14th is starting to feel tight to me. not saying it's impossible but I'd like to hear you say it out loud on a call rather than reading a green status in a doc. what does tomorrow look like
can we skip this week's check in? genuinely nothing new from my side and I'd rather give you the hour back. still on for the following week and I'll have the merchandising sign off by then

canceling. budget is being reviewed and I've been told not to green light any new work until that's done. I hate this, I want to be clear the pause is not about the quality of anything you've delivered. I'll come back with a date as soon as I have one.

status from us: photography done, copy done, size charts still pending on about 40 SKUs. that last one is on me. can we push our check in to friday so I have something to show instead of an apology
